description: Use this when the user has confirmed a plan_site plan and its cost. Returns what was created for each site (the site, its page checks and dependencies, with ids), anything left out because the plan filled up, and what to set up next. Spends the monitors the plan priced. Safe to repeat: the same plan id returns the first result. Not for a plan the user has not seen: show them plan_site's summary first.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.
